cc:Work.dc:title: Shelf - CardHolder
cc:Work.dc:description:
Shelf for holding (multiple) piles of playing cards / notes
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes CardHolder --outside 1 --stackable 0 --Grooved_style triangle --Grooved_margin 0.1 --Grooved_interleave 1 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes CardHolder --outside --stackable --Grooved_style --Grooved_margin --Grooved_interleave --reference --labels
